page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ce4.2xlarge is an x86_64 server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.2 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The memory configuration consists of 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per core ratio. This instance operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.ce4.2xlarge in the middle tier for most general compute tasks. It achieves average scores in stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. However, memory performance shows a notable bottleneck; while small-block cached read bandwidth is average at 465.3 GB/sec, large-block uncached read bandwidth drops to a weak 37.76 GB/sec, and the Passmark memory score is also in the bottom 25 percent.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is positioned for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-speed local storage or heavy parallel floating-point calculations. It is suitable for caching layers, moderate web serving, and lightweight text or image processing. It is poorly suited for large language model inference, where a 7B model yields poor performance of 5.5 tokens per second for text generation, and database operations are weak, scoring 2270.53 in Passmark database tests.
